IT Product Delivery Manager

Apply locations Contagem, Brazil time type Full time posted on Posted 18 Days Ago job requisition id R0095502

It’s not just about your career or job title… It’s about who you are and the impact you will make on the world. Because whether it’s for each other or our customers, we put People First. When our people come together, we Expand the Possible and continuously look for ways to improve what we create and how we do it. If you are constantly striving to grow, you’re in good company. We are revolutionizing the way the world moves for future generations, and we want someone who is ready to move with us.

Essa posição é para atuar em modelo híbrido em Contagem, MG.

Who will you be working with?

Our best-in-class IT team is looking for a Product Delivery Manager to join Wabtec and build out the next generation of our platforms. They will be a key leader for our Information Technology (IT) function focused on driving and communicating product strategy, leading cross-functional projects and programs related to core technologies like VMware, OpenShift, Red Hat Linux, and Oracle.

How will you make a difference?

The ideal candidate is a hands-on project manager, has significant experience in developing software solutions and IT third-party technical relationship management. The successful candidate must have strong firsthand expertise in software development and understanding complex enterprise systems. They must be at ease working in an Agile/hybrid-agile environment with little supervision. They should embody a passion for continuous improvement and data-driven efforts.

What do we want to know about you?

  • Technical program and product management experience, specifically in the software engineering space.
  • Experience in documenting product requirements for both IT and product applications in a medium to large-scale organization.
  • Proven experience working in both Agile and Waterfall project management environments.
  • Practical skills in product requirement gathering, analysis, and documentation for infrastructure-related hardware and software products.
  • Strong understanding of business processes and the ability to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Excellent project management and program delivery skills, including experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to present to and influence leadership.
  • Proficient in data analysis and using insights to drive continuous improvement of HR technology offerings.
  • PMP, Scrum, or other relevant certifications.
  • Experience working in a global, matrixed organization
  • Exposure to IT technology implementation and change management
  • Strong technical background and understanding of IT infrastructure architectures in the Public Cloud, VMware and physical on-premises.
  • Excellent Communication and Presentation skills.
  • Advanced/Fluent English.

What will your typical day look like?

  • Manage complex, multi-workstream projects and programs to drive the implementation and adoption of new IT technologies.
    • Coordinate efforts for the complete project and product lifecycle, from conception to delivery and ongoing maintenance.
    • Translate product needs into quality requirements for stakeholders and project teams.
    • Facilitate meetings and workshops with stakeholders to review requirements, deliverables, issues, and risks.
    • Adherence to IT PMO standards and requirements.
    • Budget management, delivering projects on time, on budget, with quality.
  • Own the product roadmap and strategy for key IT platforms and services.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to define requirements, prioritize initiatives, and deliver impactful solutions.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from IT leadership to business partners.
  • Leverage data and user insights to make informed decisions and continuously improve the IT offerings.
  • Define solution boundaries and scope of deliverables.
  • Specification and documentation of functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Assist technically in training and coaching professional and technical staff.
  • Accountable for the DevOps lifecycle of managed applications, including handover of sustain structure to third parties or other support teams.

Wabtec Corporation is a leading global provider of equipment, systems, digital solutions, and value-added services for freight and transit rail as well as the mining, marine, and industrial markets. Wabtec is focused on performance that drives progress and unlocks our customers’ potential by delivering innovative and lasting transportation solutions that move and improve the world. title: Business Intelligence Developer
description:
ABOUT GREENLIGHT

GreenLight Biosciences is using RNA to create a world where plants, people, and the planet can thrive together. The company is developing highly effective agricultural solutions for farmers and beekeepers that are targeted to specific pests and degrade quickly in the environment. Our pipeline includes products to protect honeybees and a range of fruits and vegetables. The GreenLight platform allows us to research, design, and manufacture across multiple product categories including insecticides, fungicides, and herbicides.

For more information, visit

Position Overview

GreenLight Biosciences is seeking a Business Intelligence Developer to contribute to the design, development, and implementation of data visualization solutions. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work with downstream data visualization tools to enable insights and decisions across the organization, particularly in R&D, Finance, and Manufacturing workflows.

Responsibilities

  1. Collaborate within a highly cross-functional biotechnology data solutions team to deliver decision-enabling dashboards for R&D, Finance, and Manufacturing.
  2. Engage with stakeholders to understand the best data visualization solutions, using tools such as PowerBI, Tableau, Spotfire, etc.
  3. Extract and source data from custom systems from third parties, such as TOTVS, and from data warehouses.
  4. Follow Agile methodology to deliver reports and dashboards.
  5. Prepare documentation and conduct functionality tests.
  6. Clearly articulate and communicate results, solutions, and vision to stakeholders and managers.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Biotechnology, or equivalent.
  • More than 2 years of experience working with diverse datasets in a scientific solutions, commercial, or public research organization.
  • At least 5 years of experience developing dashboards from complex data models using PowerBI or similar tools like Tableau.
  • Familiarity with at least two database languages such as SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle.
  • Experience with ERP systems such as TOTVS ERP, D365 F&O, Salesforce, etc.
  • Agility and a solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong ownership and commitment to completing assignments.
  • Excellent communication skills with diverse stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or equivalent.
  • Hands-on experience in data aggregation, cleaning, normalization, and visualization within the Microsoft ecosystem.
  • Knowledge of financial, manufacturing, and lab processes and operations.
  • Proficiency in Excel, including VBA macros and advanced functions.
  • Ability to collaborate with both data and non-data personnel to implement data management systems based on user requirements.
  • Experience in software documentation and testing.

Elaborar documentos relacionados à NR12.

Curso superior em engenharia com especialização em Segurança do Trabalho (concluído ou cursando);

Curso de auditor interno (ISO 9001 /14001 / 45001).

Condução de processos de melhoria contínua;

Conhecimento em análise ergonômica do trabalho;
Cursos de especialização ou aperfeiçoamento em áreas como gestão de riscos, higiene ocupacional, primeiros socorros e riscos industriais;
Capacidade de gerenciar tempo e recursos de forma eficaz;
Habilidade para redigir relatórios técnicos claros e objetivos e para trabalhar em equipe;
Conhecimentos Técnicos: Conhecimento aprofundado das normas regulamentadoras (NRs) e das legislações pertinentes à segurança e saúde ocupacional;
Habilidades de Comunicação: Capacidade de comunicar de forma clara e eficaz, tanto na elaboração de relatórios quanto na condução de treinamentos;
Atenção aos Detalhes: Habilidade para identificar riscos e inconformidades, e propor soluções práticas e eficazes;

description:
Workplace: Embu das Artes - SP

Aqui na Ibema nós pensamos além da caixa e fazemos com tato todos os dias para criar um ambiente cheio de coragem para as nossas pessoas. Pois juntos, seguimos a jornada de embalar o futuro. Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a todas as pessoas, independentemente de cor, gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, acessibilidade, fatores culturais ou sociais. Venha conhecer nossas oportunidades!

Essa vaga possui como missão garantir a excelência operacional e a melhoria contínua dos processos logísticos através da análise de dados, otimização de processos e implementação de metodologias Lean, visando aumentar a eficiência, reduzir custos e melhorar a qualidade do serviço prestado. Irá ainda, atuar de forma proativa na identificação de problemas e oportunidades de melhoria, liderando iniciativas que promovam a inovação e a automação tecnológica dentro da cadeia.

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Melhoria na Eficiência Operacional;
  • Otimização de Processos Logísticos;
  • Atuação em Projetos de Melhoria;
  • Implementação de Ferramentas Lean;
  • Promoção da Cultura de Melhoria Contínua;
  • Inovação e Automação Tecnológica.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino Superior em Administração de Empresas;
  • Desejável Inglês intermediário;
  • Conhecimento em Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Internet of Things (IoT) e Inteligência Artificial (AI);
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Lists, Power apps e Power automate;
  • Habilidade em identificar e implementar soluções tecnológicas para automação de processos;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de Business Intelligence (BI) como Power BI e Tableau;
  • Habilidade em análise de dados utilizando Excel, SQL e Python.

Aqui na Ibema fazemos com tato e pensamos em soluções para embalar seu futuro. Por isso, oferecemos benefícios para seu bem estar e qualidade de vida, para que se sintam amparados a traçar uma jornada com a gente e se fazer pertencentes a equipe Ibema!

Benefícios:

  • Sua saúde é prioridade para nós. Por isso garantimos Convênio Médico para você e sua família;
  • Adoramos sorrisos, então é claro que temos Convênio Odontológico incluso nos benefícios;
  • Facilitamos sua compra em farmácias com o nosso Convênio Farmácia;
  • Alimentação saudável é essencial, assim damos incentivo para facilitar ainda mais seu dia a dia! Possuímos Refeitório ou Vale Refeição a depender da unidade. Além do Vale Alimentação para compras em supermercados;
  • Seu caminho até a empresa está assegurado! Temos a disponibilidade do Vale Transporte ou Transporte Fretado para os colaboradores que estão presencialmente nas unidades;
  • Nada tem mais valor do que a vida! Por isso, em caso de falecimento ou invalidez sua família não estará desamparada, para isso temos o Seguro de Vida e você escolhe quem será seu beneficiário;
  • Priorizamos seu desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, assim concedemos ao colaborador Bolsas de Estudos com subsídios de até 50%, com elegibilidade a partir de 06 meses de empresa.
  • Oferecemos treinamentos e cursos para aperfeiçoamento profissional. Além disso, possuímos o POI (Programas de Oportunidades Internas) , onde cada colaborador pode aproveitar uma oportunidade interna se inscrever e concorre a uma vaga que deseja, afim de buscar o crescimento dentro da empresa;
  • Ofertamos PPR, para compartilharmos o que conquistamos juntos;
  • Você pode contar conosco em momentos difíceis, oferecemos o benefício de APOIO PASS , com apoio psicológico, financeiro, jurídico e social com atendimento 24 horas por dia a 7 dias da semana;
  • Ajudamos a manter sua saúde física e mental com o GYMPASS uma plataforma de academias, estúdios, pilates e natação. Disponível para o colaborador e até 3 dependentes.

Embalamos o futuro

Desde 1955, produzimos papéis para embalagens de maneira inovadora e sustentável para o Brasil e para o mundo. Hoje, temos orgulho de falar que somos a 3° maior fabricante de papelcartão do Brasil!

Aqui você encontra pessoas que acreditam no papel da coragem e apostam em novas ideias para tornar nosso produto, e a sua experiência, cada vez mais surpreendente. Afinal, nosso trabalho é feito com inteligência e com tato .

O fruto do nosso suor é o papelcartão certo para quem se preocupa com o meio ambiente pois, muito mais do que produtos, existimos para embalar bem-estar, histórias e um futuro sustentável.

title: Comprador Pleno
description:
Sao Paulo, BR

RESUMO

Realizar todas as atividades e rotinas da área de Compras junto aos fornecedores para suprir as necessidades de transporte e serviços da empresa, garantindo o abastecimento e continuidade das operações, obtendo as melhores condições comerciais e de qualidade, focando as metas estabelecidas pela Empresa.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Receber e classificar as requisições de compras, selecionando-as por grupo de transporte e serviços e emitir o pedido de compras, efetuando pesquisas de preços junto a fornecedores qualificados.
  2. Reunir-se, eventualmente, e visitar fornecedores para negociação de preços e prazos.
  3. Solicitar propostas para obtenção de preços e informações técnicas, selecionando fornecedores para suas diversas áreas de atuação.
  4. Elaborar e negociar preços e condições gerais de entrega.
  5. Elaborar e analisar contratos de transporte com os fornecedores, avaliando juntamente com a área Jurídica da empresa se a descrição está condizente com o acordado com o fornecedor.
  6. Acompanhar os processos do início até a entrega e o pagamento de fornecedores.
  7. Fornecer suporte às operações com indicações de fornecedores e históricos de compras.
  8. Buscar e avaliar novos fornecedores, verificando o cumprimento dos critérios de qualidade, idoneidade, condições de fornecimento, entre outros, com o objetivo de manter a CEVA atualizada com as tendências de mercado.
  9. Preparar relatórios gerenciais, apontando custos e volumes de compra, para suportar a tomada de decisão.
  10. Manter os KIP’s da área de compras de transporte atualizados.
  11. Executar outras atividades inerentes e correlatas ao cargo.

REQUISITOS MÍNIMOS

  • Formação Superior Completa;
  • Experiência em Compras de Transportes (Operação Porto X Planta);
  • Pacote Office – Avançado;
  • Inglês Intermediário;
  • Residir em São Paulo ou região;

Na CEVA Logistics, apoiamos e valorizamos a diversidade e não fazemos distinção de candidatos com deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia ou idade. Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor, seguro, diverso e inclusivo, que incentiva a troca de conhecimentos e experiências, sempre com muito respeito às diferenças.

Com uma cultura sólida de reconhecimento e oportunidades internas, queremos que nossos colaboradores cresçam, se desenvolvam e façam parte de nossa jornada. Oferecemos um pacote de benefícios competitivos do setor. Aqui possuímos uma meta ousada de crescimento profissional interno, então, se quiser trabalhar para um dos principais operadores logísticos do mundo, se inscreva nas nossas posições em aberto.

Valorizamos o seu crescimento profissional e pessoal. É por isso que compartilhamos muitas oportunidades para iniciar sua jornada na CEVA. Junte-se a nós para uma carreira desafiadora.

title: Field Applications Engineer
description:
Description

ABEC is at the forefront of innovation in our industry, offering highly differentiated products and services driving exceptional growth. As we expand to meet increased demand and new opportunities, we seek talented individuals to join our team and support our continued success.

We’re in a significant growth phase, with multiple key roles open across our organization. If you’re qualified for multiple positions, we encourage you to apply for the role that aligns most with your skills and experience.

Company Background:

For 50 years, ABEC has been a leading engineering, equipment and services supplier to the biopharmaceutical manufacturing industry. ABEC’s unique value is based on combining long experience with the ability to engineer, design, manufacture, commission, qualify, and service the entire bioprocess to reduce overall cost, shorten time to market, and maximize productivity. To support our growing field services business, ABEC is seeking an experienced Field Applications Engineer.

Benefits include:

  1. Paid holidays and vacation time
  2. Medical, dental and vision insurance (benefits start day 1)
  3. Company paid life insurance
  4. Generous 401K plan (40% match)
  5. College tuition benefit program
  6. Employee Referral Program

Position Summary:

The Field Applications Engineer is a customer-facing role providing technical support to ABEC’s Sales function and directly to customers. S/he teams with regional sales managers to identify and understand process and equipment improvement opportunities at customer sites, develop and propose solutions, and support delivery of those solutions. Process and equipment improvement opportunities include a variety of troubleshooting, consulting, repair, modification, and upgrade services that improve productivity, accelerate time to market, and reduce operating cost. The Field Applications Engineer is part of the Services Business Unit and interfaces internally with that team as well as other ABEC technical groups and subject matter experts to develop scope, cost, schedules, and proposals for these services. In summary, the Field Applications Engineer is a trusted resource supporting the delivery of high value field services and growth of ABEC’s Services customer base.

Responsibilities:

  1. Collaborate with colleagues in the definition and development of technical and commercial proposals often within tight deadlines. Ensure timely review and response to client requests for proposals.
  2. Interpret customer performance requirements and develop optimal technical solutions. Interface with ABEC Operations functions (PM, PC, Engineering/Design, Automation, Quality) to communicate customer needs and obtain appropriate proposal content.
  3. Exercise judgement and good communication in resolving conflicting customer expectations in terms of price, performance or schedule.
  4. Sales Support – Ensure effective support of Sales including advice on product strategies for identified opportunities, ABEC expertise at meetings with clients, training on product capabilities/differentiation, and bid decisions. Work with customers to thoroughly understand what they want to achieve and determine a fit for ABEC products. Clearly articulate the ABEC value proposition in a way that is relevant to the specific customer need.
  5. Marketing and Product Management – Provide technical content for marketing tools (presentations, brochures, website content, etc.) for effective communication of ABEC product features, benefits, and differentiation.
  6. Train both sales and applications on product capabilities and differentiation. Support sales as product expert at meetings with customers remotely and face-to-face in the field.
  7. Contribute to Continuous Improvement initiatives related to Service or other functions.
  8. Track competitor capabilities and activities.
  9. Other duties as assigned by the VP of Sales.

Qualifications:

  1. Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Science.
  2. Minimum 5 years’ experience in biopharma capital equipment engineering/design, bioprocess engineering, and/or biopharma manufacturing operations/maintenance.
  3. Experience with bioprocess equipment such as fermenters, bioreactors, filtration, chromatography, CIP, Single Use Systems, and/or sanitary vessels.
  4. Demonstrated ability to understand and navigate both technical issues and commercial situations.
  5. Strong communications and interpersonal skills.
  6. Prior experience in Field Service or Applications is preferred.
  7. Ability to travel approximately 60%.

title: Roadshow “Noronha te Aguarda” capacitará agentes de viagens em São Paulo
description:
Capacitação sobre Fernando de Noronha (Divulgação/APFN)

O Roadshow “Noronha te Aguarda” chega à sua segunda etapa, com ações estratégicas em São Paulo, Campinas, Ribeirão Preto e São José do Rio Preto entre esta terça (13) e sexta-feira (16). A iniciativa busca capacitar agentes de viagens para conectar turistas do interior paulista ao destino, oferecendo experiências únicas e personalizadas.

A ação promovida pela Associação das Pousadas de Fernando de Noronha (APFN), em parceria com a Empetur, visa fortalecer o turismo sustentável na ilha. O evento inclui capacitações sobre biodiversidade, estrutura de hospedagem e práticas sustentáveis, além de destacar experiências autênticas e exclusivas.

Para a vice-presidente da associação e hoteleira, Fabiana de Sanctis, Fernando de Noronha é um dos destinos mais emblemáticos do Brasil, e preservá-lo é um dos grandes desafios e compromissos da APFN.

“Noronha não é apenas um destino, mas uma experiência incomparável, onde cada detalhe é pensado para proporcionar momentos únicos em sintonia com a natureza. Nosso compromisso é conectar viajantes exigentes ao que há de mais autêntico e sofisticado na ilha”, assinala.

De acordo com dados da gestão da ilha, os turistas de São Paulo foram um dos principais grupos que visitaram Fernando de Noronha em 2024. Nesse ano, a ilha bateu recorde de visitantes, com 131.503 turistas, um aumento de 9,2% em relação a 2023.

A iniciativa “Noronha te Aguarda” reforça a importância da qualificação do setor para manter Fernando de Noronha como referência nacional e internacional em turismo de experiência e responsabilidade ambiental. Até o final do ano, o projeto terá realizado 13 eventos e capacitado cerca de 520 agentes de viagens brasileiros.

Manuela Fay e Fabiana de Sanctis, representantes da Associação das Pousadas de Fernando de Noronha (Divulgação/APFN)

Experiências sob medida para cada viajante

Segundo Manuela Fay, diretora executiva da APFN, capacitar agentes de viagens é fundamental para garantir que a experiência dos turistas em Noronha seja planejada de forma personalizada e responsável.

“Buscamos formar profissionais que compreendam a singularidade do arquipélago e saibam orientar os viajantes sobre hospedagens, roteiros sustentáveis e vivências únicas. Ao ampliar esse conhecimento, fortalecemos a qualidade do atendimento ao turista, estimulamos vendas e promovemos experiências que respeitam o equilíbrio ecológico da ilha”, afirma.

Os visitantes podem desfrutar de hospedagens que oferecem atendimento exclusivo e serviços diferenciados, disponíveis para consulta no site oficial da associação . Além das pousadas, experiências como passeios de barco exclusivos, trilhas guiadas e observação da vida marinha garantem uma imersão completa na beleza e biodiversidade da ilha.

Destino ideal para os turistas do Sudeste

Com acesso facilitado e voos regulares, a ilha se torna uma opção prática para os visitantes do Sudeste. Atualmente, há voos diretos e com escala de São Paulo para Fernando de Noronha operados por diferentes companhias aéreas:

Voos Diretos

  • Latam: Rota direta entre São Paulo (Guarulhos – GRU) e Fernando de Noronha (FEN), com cinco frequências semanais (segundas, quartas, quintas, sextas e domingos). O tempo de voo é de aproximadamente 3h50.
  • Gol: Também opera voos diretos entre Guarulhos e Noronha, com aeronaves Boeing 737 MAX 8.
  • Azul: Oferece voos com conexão em Recife (REC) antes de seguir para Noronha.
  • Gol: Além dos voos diretos, também tem opções com escala em Recife.

Exclusividade e tarifas especiais

Até junho, os viajantes têm a oportunidade de explorar Fernando de Noronha com tarifas especiais em pousadas de alto padrão, aproveitando a baixa temporada. “Este é o momento perfeito para desfrutar da beleza intocada da ilha, com menos movimento e um atendimento ainda mais diferenciado. As pousadas associadas à APFN oferecem o máximo em conforto, luxo e sustentabilidade, garantindo uma estadia inesquecível para quem busca um destino sofisticado e de alto valor agregado”, afirma Lucia Smith.

title: Tech UI Designer
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN What We Do

We design customer and user-focused experiences that are fresh and innovative while problem-solving by anticipating user behavior and hurdles. We approach the most complex of challenges and address them with simple, intuitive, and valuable solutions.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is seeking talented, experienced Technical UI Designers to work on Fortnite. In this position, you will have a role as a collaborative team member implementing UI systems design in Unreal engine, building rapid prototypes, layouts, visual scripting, and leveling up our workflows. You will work with UX Designers, UI Artists, and UI Engineers to ship these features to millions of users worldwide. The ideal candidate would have expertise in introductory algebra and geometry math ("Game math"), game systems, and fundamental programming principles.

In this role, you will

  • Work on UI Systems Design, break down feature/wireframes into necessary widgets, structures, and classes; increase UI performance by ensuring best practices are followed by colleagues.
  • Ensure assets/UI are within memory and CPU constraints. Learning to profile performance and the costs of UMG/Slate/C++/and texture memory.
  • Implement blueprint logic when presentation logic calls for it. Assist UI Artists where necessary in implementing special presentation behavior. Consult with UI engineers on the logic that will be in the blueprint vs native code.
  • Debug blueprints/UMG issues quickly using various tools and techniques.
  • Find ways to assist UX, UI Art, and UI engineering in organization, documentation, and building workflow improvements.

What we’re looking for

  • 3-6+ years of experience in building UI and experiences in game engines and across multiple platforms (mobile, web, pc, consoles) or similar transferable experience.
  • 2+ years of experience shipping updates and new features to a user base on a regular cadence or similar transferable experience.
  • Professional experience using Photoshop, Figma, and game engines (Custom engine, Unity, UE4, Lumberyard, Snowdrop, etc.), and an understanding of game industry 3D-package experience (3D Studio, Maya, etc.).
  • You have an eye for pixel-perfect UI, translating and spotting various potential issues with mockups as you help see the designs into the engine.
  • You are a logical problem solver and have attention to detail.
  • You can "translate" communication across departments (talk to engineering about UI Art needs, summarize technical issues, etc.), but also have empathy for non-technical team members and the ability to empower others on your team.

If you have a portfolio/reel/website you'd like to share, please hyperlink it to your resume, or submit it as an attachment with your application.

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here .

Note to Recruitment Agencies: Epic does not accept any unsolicited resumes or approaches from any unauthorized third party (including recruitment or placement agencies) (i.e., a third party with whom we do not have a negotiated and validly executed agreement). We will not pay any fees to any unauthorized third party. Further details on these matters can be found here .

Title: Compensation and Benefits Specialist - Laguna

Job Summary:

The Total Rewards Specialist is a critical member of the HR team responsible for co-designing, administering, and continuously improving compensation, benefits, rewards, employee mobility, and workforce data reporting processes. Operating in a fast-paced, highly technical manufacturing environment, this role ensures that total rewards programs are competitive, equitable, legally compliant, and aligned with the company’s talent strategy and growth plans.

This position works closely with cross-functional teams—including Employee Relations and Business Partnering, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, and Site Operations—to deliver a compelling and data-driven employee value proposition that supports business objectives while fostering employee engagement and retention.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Compensation & Benefits Strategy and Operations:

  • Support the design and implementation of competitive and equitable compensation structures for various roles across the organization.
  • Support to conduct job evaluations and benchmarking using market data and industry comparators to ensure internal equity and external competitiveness.
  • Manage day-to-day administration of statutory and company-provided benefits, including health insurance, group life insurance, retirement plans, leave benefits, and wellness initiatives.
  • Ensure all benefits programs are compliant with Philippine laws and regulations (DOLE, SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, BIR, etc.) and manage regular audit readiness.

2. New Hire and Job Candidate Compensation:

  • Evaluate job offers and determine compensation packages that balance market competitiveness, internal equity, and salary ranges.
  • Serve as a compensation advisor to Talent Acquisition and hiring managers by offering compensation scenarios and guidance on starting salaries, premiums, and pay ranges for roles being filled.
  • Contribute to the calibration of hiring rates for new roles based on market data, production demands, and talent availability.

3. Cyclical Compensation Planning:

  • Coordinate the end-to-end annual compensation review process including merit increases, market adjustments, annual bonuses, and promotions.
  • Develop compensation planning tools, review analytics, and ensure accurate application of compensation guidelines across departments.
  • Support calibration sessions and decision-making by preparing dashboards and pay distribution insights.
  • Maintain and track promotion decisions, ensuring fairness, internal alignment, and documentation integrity.

4. Employee Mobility:

  • Facilitate local and international mobility programs such as employee transfers, relocations, and assignments.
  • Coordinate mobility-related logistics, including relocation allowances, housing, transportation, and tax implications.
  • Partner with external vendors for immigration and documentation requirements for foreign or regionally mobile staff.
  • Monitor mobility costs and ensure adherence to internal policies and labor laws.

5. Rewards & Recognition:

  • Administer and continuously improve the company’s recognition programs, including service awards, on-the-spot recognitions, team awards, and performance-based acknowledgments.
  • Design new initiatives that recognize behavior aligned with company values and operational excellence, especially in plant settings.
  • Analyze program participation and effectiveness and recommend enhancements to boost employee engagement and culture-building.

6. Reporting, Analytics & Workforce Data Monitoring:

  • Reporting and analysis of key HR and workforce metrics, including:
  • Total rewards cost analysis
  • Compensation distribution and equity tracking
  • Benefits utilization trends
  • Headcount movement and attrition
  • Time and attendance, overtime trends, and work hour patterns
  • New hire activity and demographic breakdown
  • Provide high-quality data to support decision-making in compensation reviews, strategic workforce planning, and operational audits.
  • Ensure data integrity across all platforms (HRIS, payroll systems, attendance tracking) and support continuous improvement in HR data governance.
  • Collaborate with HRIS and Finance teams to automate, streamline, and improve reporting capabilities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Finance, Psychology, or a related field.
  • 5 - 8 years of solid experience in compensation and benefits, total rewards, or HR operations, ideally in a manufacturing, electronics, or high-tech environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Philippine labor laws and government-mandated benefits.
  • Experience in the industries of power systems, electronics manufacturing, and semiconductor sectors.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards) and experience using HR systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Workday.
  • Demonstrated experience in compensation planning cycles and developing workforce dashboards.
  • High level of integrity and confidentiality in managing sensitive employee data.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with a proactive and solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Certifications such as CCP (Certified Compensation Professional), CBP (Certified Benefits Professional), or GMS (Global Mobility Specialist) are a plus.

Core Competencies:

  • Total Rewards Expertise: Understanding of compensation frameworks, benefits structures, and their impact on workforce motivation and retention.
  • Data Analysis & Reporting: Ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for HR and business leaders.
  • Project Management: Skilled in managing cyclical HR events such as annual salary reviews, promotion cycles, and policy updates.
  • Compliance & Governance: Deep awareness of local labor regulations and commitment to regulatory compliance.
  • Business Acumen: Aligns HR initiatives with operational and financial realities of manufacturing and technical work environments.
  • Communication & Influence: Able to explain rewards-related matters clearly to various audiences and influence decision-making with data and logic.

description:
Technical Support Engineer II - Microsoft

Join to apply for the Technical Support Engineer II - Microsoft role at Docusign

Technical Support Engineer II - Microsoft

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Company Overview
Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you'll do

As a Technical Support Engineer specializing in Microsoft services, you will act as a trusted advisor to customers while serving as a technical escalation point for complex issues related to Docusign’s Microsoft integrations. You will provide exceptional support across APIs, network environments, and web-based workflows, helping customers maximize adoption and performance. You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Support teams to solve problems and advocate for product improvements that enhance customer experience. This role is part of our global Customer Success team and plays a critical role in ensuring service excellence and operational efficiency.

This position is an individual contributor role reporting to the Manager, Technical Support.

Responsibilities

  • Provide advanced technical support for Docusign’s Microsoft integrations, including SharePoint, Power Automate, Dynamics, and Logic Apps
  • Manage and resolve escalated support cases related to API usage, embedded workflows, network issues, authentication, and system integrations
  • Use technical expertise to increase customer adoption and troubleshoot complex scenarios
  • Analyze product logs and network traces using tools such as Wireshark, Fiddler, and browser developer tools
  • Utilize tools like Salesforce, Jira, internal admin consoles, and logging systems to track and resolve support issues
  • Identify product defects and suggest improvements to enhance Microsoft-related customer workflows
  • Promote Docusign solutions through consultative dialogue and understanding of support needs
  • Meet or exceed service level goals specific to the Microsoft integration support domain

Job Designation

Remote: Employee is not required to be in or near an office frequently and works from a designated remote work location for the majority of the time.

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

What you bring

Basic

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • 2+ years of experience in SaaS technical support or NOC roles
  • Experience troubleshooting in web-based environments (HTTP, JSON, HTML, CSS, IIS)
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft SharePoint (on-prem and SaaS), Power Automate, Dynamics, and Logic Apps
  • Experience with Windows PowerShell scripting
  • Experience in Microsoft system administration
  • Experience with log analysis tools such as Wireshark, Fiddler, or Charles Proxy

Preferred

  • 1-2+ years as a Support Expert for Docusign or similar technologies
  • Strong communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience supporting embedded signing, On-Demand Signature Service, or Docusign Central
  • Familiarity with Docusign CLM workflows and architecture
  • Mastery of regular expressions, code debugging, and complex data validation
  • Experience with REST and SOAP APIs, SDKs, and authentication (SAML, OAuth)
  • Prior use of Dynatrace or similar monitoring tools
  • Experience with internal logging tools and backend troubleshooting
  • Microsoft certifications or equivalent industry credentials
  • Professional experience in a relevant vertical supported by Docusign
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented with excellent organizational and time management skills

Life at Docusign

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. You will feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a progressive omnichannel growth marketing agency focused on retail, e-commerce, and consumer businesses. We have been recognized as one of the fastest growing private companies in America by Inc. 5000 (2023), a top 1% digital advertiser by Varos (2023), and our founders were named Forbes 30 Under 30 recipients for Marketing and Advertising North America (2024).
Who we’re looking for
We are hiring a Lead Designer — a proven designer generalist who brings stunning visual craft, exceptional attention to detail, and a high standard of quality to their work.
You’re comfortable executing multiple different types of engagements: UI/UX and web, brand design, creative direction, paid marketing ads, emails, social posts.
You love working with clients that are in need of design expertise and turning their creative outputs into beautiful, branded assets that perform and make business impact.
This is a highly creative role that requires someone that thrives on independence, cross-functional navigation, and a get-it-done attitude. You’ll report to a Director of Creative on our team and maintain ownership of high-impact design projects. This is a challenging, fast-paced environment with high levels of autonomy and accountability. From day to day, you may work with Retention Managers to design brand new flows on a tight deadline, and the next day you may jump to your own Web Design engagement that you’re managing independently. You’ll work directly with Founders and Executives across a portfolio of high-growth U.S. brands—an opportunity that accelerates professional development, strategic thinking, and creative leadership. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.
This is a fully remote role operating in the EST time zone. Candidates must be professionally fluent in English. Open to applicants based in Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain .
What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective business reasoning, trade-offs, and UX principles.
  • Lead 1-2 UI/UX (web design) engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand-off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Understand what drives customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.
  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.
  • Design landing pages within Figma and Instant.so, our no-code landing page builder, by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.
  • Develop hand-off documentation in Figma for developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design engagements, and more.
  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to a Director of Creative. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.
You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)
  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong web design and marketing design that is brand-focused. E-commerce focus preferred.
  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.
  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.
  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.
  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.

description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented B2 Licensed Aircraft Engineer to join our maintenance team. In this role, you will be responsible for the electrical, electronic, and avionics systems of aircraft. As a B2 Licensed Aircraft Engineer, you will work alongside a dedicated team of engineers and technicians, ensuring that all electrical and avionics systems are maintained to the highest safety and performance standards.

Your responsibilities will include troubleshooting, conducting routine inspections, and performing repairs on aircraft avionics systems such as communication, navigation, and radar systems. This role is essential for ensuring that aircraft are safe and comply with aviation regulations, making it a critical position within the aviation industry.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Perform scheduled and unscheduled maintenance on aircraft avionics and electrical systems.
  • Troubleshoot and repair aircraft electronics, including communication, navigation, radar, and autopilot systems.
  • Conduct pre-flight and post-flight inspections of electrical and avionics systems to ensure airworthiness.
  • Carry out avionics modifications and upgrades in accordance with manufacturer and regulatory guidelines.
  • Read and interpret wiring diagrams, technical manuals, and engineering documents to diagnose issues.
  • Complete maintenance documentation and logbooks accurately, recording all work performed.
  • Collaborate with the flight crew to ensure all avionics systems are functioning properly.
  • Calibrate and test avionics instruments to ensure proper operation.
  • Supervise and guide junior technicians in the completion of their tasks.
  • Ensure all maintenance activities comply with safety and regulatory standards.
  • Liaise with regulatory authorities and participate in audits or inspections as required.
  • Stay updated on new technologies, regulations, and industry best practices in avionics and electrical systems.
Qualifications:
  • Valid EASA Part 66 B2 License (or equivalent recognized by local aviation authorities).
  • Extensive knowledge of aircraft electrical, electronics, and avionics systems, including communication, navigation, and autopilot systems.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in aircraft avionics maintenance or modifications.
  • Strong diagnostic and troubleshooting skills with avionics equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret complex wiring diagrams, schematics, and technical manuals.
  • Proficiency in using electrical testing equipment, such as multimeters and oscilloscopes.
  • High attention to detail and a commitment to safety.
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment and meet tight deadlines.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • EASA Part 66 B2 License or equivalent qualification (e.g., FAA A&P License with avionics endorsement, CAA B2 License).
  • Aircraft Type Ratings on relevant aircraft models (e.g., Airbus, Boeing, Bombardier, etc.).
  • Human Factors certification.
  • Current EWIS (Electrical Wiring Interconnection System) certificate.
  • Fuel Tank Safety certification (Level 1 and 2 preferred).
  • Updated training on relevant regulations (Part 145, Part M, etc.).
  • Type ratings on multiple aircraft types.
  • Experience with advanced avionics systems, including modern glass cockpit technology (e.g., Garmin, Honeywell, Rockwell Collins).
  • Experience in both line and base maintenance environments.
  • Certification in avionics troubleshooting techniques.

A Syngenta é uma empresa líder do seguimento de agricultura que ajuda a melhorar a segurança alimentar global, permitindo que milhões de agricultores façam um melhor uso dos recursos disponíveis.
Através da ciência, tecnologia de ponta e soluções inovadoras de cultivo, os nossos quase 60.000 colaboradores em mais de 100 países estão trabalhando para transformar a maneira como as culturas são feitas. ### Consolidation and Reporting

  • Oversee the financial consolidation process, ensuring accuracy and timeliness of consolidated financial statements

  • Prepare and present comprehensive financial reports and analyses for senior management and stakeholders
  • Ensure compliance with relevant accounting standards and regulatory requirements
### Stakeholder Management
  • Act as the primary finance point of contact for business unit leaders and key stakeholders
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Facilitate effective communication between finance and other departments
  • Present financial information and insights to non-financial audiences in a clear and impactful manner
### Business Partnering
  • Provide financial support and guidance to business units in decision-making processes
  • Conduct financial modeling and scenario analysis to support business planning
  • Identify opportunities for cost savings, revenue growth, and process improvements
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams on budgeting, forecasting, and performance analysis
Qualifications
## Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Job experience in finance, with a focus on consolidation, reporting, and business partnering
  • Understanding of financial consolidation processes and reporting standards (IFRS, GAAP)
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and financial modeling
  • Experience with ERP systems and financial planning tools
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Intermediate English is desirable
## Skills and Competencies
  • Strategic thinking and business acumen
  • Leadership and mentoring capabilities
  • Stakeholder management and relationship building
  • Financial analysis and interpretation
  • Project management
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Adaptability and resilience
Additional Information
Location: São Paulo (hybrid model, 3x on site)
A Syngenta Oferece
  • Remuneração e benefícios competitivos;
  • Oportunidades de desenvolvimento;
  • Modelo híbrido de trabalho.
Mais do que acreditar somente no poder da diversidade, a Syngenta vem promovendo uma cultura inclusiva que abrange as diferenças em todas as formas. Aqui, acreditamos que o sentimento de pertencimento permite que as pessoas sejam as melhores versões de si mesmas, construindo um ambiente cada vez mais acolhedor e produtivo. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para as vagas, sem distinção de raça, gênero, idade, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

description:
Senior-Level Android Developer

São Paulo-SP, Brazil or Porto Alegre-RS, Brazil

Who We Are

In 2021, Poatek was acquired by WillowTree, an award-winning digital product consultancy recognized as one of the fastest growing and best places to work in the United States. Now a TELUS International company , with offices across the globe, we continue to partner with the world’s leading brands, such as the NBA, Capital One, HBO, PepsiCo, Domino’s and more, to design, build, and transform their digital products and strategies. We’re looking to grow our Poatek offices in Brazil with top talent excited to collaborate with team members across the globe to deliver innovative solutions for our clients.

Location and Flexibility

This is a hybrid role, which we’ve termed Work from Near (WFN). This model requires the ability to work on-site from our São Paulo - SP or Porto - RS office throughout the week based on team needs, while still providing the flexibility to work remotely on other days. Our WFN culture is designed to foster in-person innovation, collaboration, and connection with team members local and visiting from other global offices.

The Opportunity

Poatek is seeking an experienced Senior Android Engineer to join our team. You will be responsible for architecting, building, and shipping high-quality Android software applications. As a senior engineer, you’ll provide technical guidance, mentorship, and champion best practices for software development.

Responsibilities

  1. Design and develop high-quality Android software applications
  2. Build and ship durable, secure, scalable, and always-up software code
  3. Architect robust networking and data modeling layers
  4. Provide recommendations on the best ways to solve a problem for a particular platform
  5. Champion programming best practices and modular design patterns
  6. Own the delivery of major features and components
  7. Mentor other developers
  8. Collaborate and communicate with teams and clients to deliver software in an agile environment
  9. Improve existing code to make it more maintainable, testable, and elegant
  10. Practice pair programming
  11. Write unit tests to ensure code coverage
  12. Participate in Scrum and/or Kanban processes and ceremonies

Qualifications

  1. At least 5 years of professional programming experience
  2. Strong understanding of the Android development lifecycle and ecosystem
  3. Familiarity with languages, frameworks, and libraries such as Java, Kotlin, Room, Coroutines/Flow, RxJava, Dagger 2, Gradle, Fragments, OkHttp3, Retrofit or Volley
  4. Comfortable using IDEs, version control such as Git, and/or command line tools
  5. Experience with CI/CD and setting up deployment pipelines
  6. Familiarity with automated testing frameworks such as Espresso, JUnit, Mockito/Mockk, and Appium
  7. Experience with Google APIs and SDKs
  8. Experience with Hilt
  9. Developed for multiple Android platforms
  10. Appreciation for inclusive and accessible UI implementations
  11. Experience using Jetpack Compose
  12. Experience with emerging technologies such as Machine Learning, Voice, and/or AR/VR
  13. Motivated by solving problems and finding creative solutions
  14. Believe in autonomy and taking initiative
  15. Driven by curiosity and enthusiastic about learning new technologies
  16. Proactive in identifying risks and solution-oriented
  17. Able to balance business goals and technical constraints
  18. Value daily opportunities to immerse themselves deeply in their work
  19. Celebrate differences and thrive in a diverse environment
  20. Value feedback culture that fosters personal and professional growth.

Why Poatek?

What We Offer:

  1. Be part of an innovative consultancy with a human-centered culture and opportunities for ownership and professional growth
  2. Competitive salary and benefits package (annual bonus)
  3. Opportunity to work on innovative agile projects with other high-performing, passionate team members from all over the globe (international travel opportunities)
  4. Collaborative work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development (including English classes, support in national and international courses)
  5. Flexible work hours and autonomy
  6. Voucher for health activities, food allowance, in-office snacks, drinks, and games

If you love IT as much as we do, we look forward to meeting you!

Equality is a principle here at Poatek. We are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Therefore we provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, or disability.

title: QA/QC Engineer
description:
Services_EMEA-E545

QA/QC Engineer – Full Time – Basra, Iraq

Join our Services_EMEA team within Services division in Iraq as QA/QC Engineer.

Purpose of the job – to support the Quality Processes by completion of Inspection & Test Plans and procedures relating to welding and other specialist processes to ensure timely delivery of client projects.

Your main tasks and responsibilities:

  1. Attend Order Review Meetings and develop Inspection & Test Plans for new projects through tracking all quality activities within the manufacturing cycle (from receipt of raw materials to final testing and dispatch).
  2. Attend client kick off meetings / Pre-Inspection Meetings in order to obtain outline of project requirements.
  3. Prepare project plans.
  4. Determine the PS / SQA requirements that are applicable to ensure that components are ordered with the correct levels of quality to meet both Sulzer and Customer requirements.
  5. Support Manufacturing and Assembly activities.
  6. Generate drawings as required.
  7. Deal with queries from purchasing/suppliers as to exact requirements of SQA / PS documents.
  8. Provide input into partnership suppliers reviews on quality of items received and match to Sulzer requirements.
  9. Provide input to tendering process on quality requirements required in OED.
  10. Prepare documents for customer review and respond to comments made against these documents resolving any issues raised.
  11. Develop Assembly Review Sheets from details contained in quality plan, advising production of particular requirements.
  12. Attend project assembly review meetings as and when required to provide input and advise on quality element of assembly process.
  13. Update Assembly Review Sheets on feedback received via NCRs.
  14. Develop quality procedures.
  15. Ensure all processes are completed within Sulzer and/or industry standards.
  16. Completion of Non-Destructive Testing procedures and other specialist procedures (e.g. Hydro Test).
  17. Undertake Certification Review as required.
  18. Co-ordinate External Inspections as required.
  19. Undertake material releases as required.
  20. Familiar with the environmental aspects and impacts of the activities and processes involved in the role and the procedures, practices and measures to manage the impact.
  21. Familiar with the risks and hazards within the activities and processes of the role and procedures, practices and measures in place to mitigate the risks.
  22. Reporting on the performance of the quality management system and on opportunities for improvement, in particular to top management.
  23. Ensuring that the integrity of the quality management system is maintained when changes to the quality management system are planned and implemented.

What you bring to Sulzer:

  1. University Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  2. Relevant experience within Oil&Gas industry.
  3. Knowledge of quality processes and procedures.
  4. Experience with Rotating Machinery such as pumps, compressors and turbines.
  5. CAD experience.
  6. Reverse Engineering experience.
  7. Organisation skills.
  8. Customer service skills.
  9. Ability to act independently.
  10. Flexibility and ability to adapt to change.
  11. Attention to detail.
  12. General computer skills.

Working schedule – rotation basis (4 weeks on / 4 weeks off).

Location – Basra, Iraq.

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

At Sulzer, you are empowered to deliver superior results. As a pioneer in industry we have a proud heritage of innovation and continue to evolve for the future. Join our story and create your own impact by developing your expertise and building solutions that help make our lives safer, smarter and more sustainable.

Analista Pleno de Planejamento de Manutenção para Mercado Envios

Join to apply for the Analista Pleno de Planejamento de Manutenção para Mercado Envios role at Mercado Livre Brasil

No Mercado Livre estamos democratizando o comércio e os serviços financeiros para transformar a vida das pessoas na América Latina. Faça parte deste propósito!

No Mercado Envios administramos o estoque de nossos vendedores e entregamos os produtos aos nossos compradores, melhorando sua experiência em nossa plataforma. Em um mundo em constante evolução, nossa capacidade para entregar rapidamente os produtos que são comprados através do Mercado Livre tornou-se um requisito para competir. Faça parte da equipe que está liderando a logística na América Latina, oferecendo soluções customizadas de classe mundial e integrando carriers locais e regionais, através de um comércio que não reconhece fronteiras.

  • Dão o máximo, porque adoram trabalhar com compromisso e dedicação.
  • Encaram as mudanças como oportunidades e aprendem com seus erros.

description:

Description

Kenvue is currently recruiting for:

Who We Are

At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA, AVEENO, TYLENOL, LISTERINE, JOHNSON’S and BAND-AID that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent. Our global team is made by 22,000 diverse and brilliant people, passionate about insights, innovation and committed to deliver the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means to have the power to impact life of millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future – and yours.

What You Will Do

The PIC (Principal, Inventory and Costing) Finance team is responsible for Inventory Management, complex financial transactions and flows, costing and intercompany pricing. The Senior Financial Analyst will play a key role in ensuring a high-quality service delivery model through strong collaboration across the Business and Finance. Understanding of the SC processes, systems, and ability to effectively frame and communicate with senior leaders will be important to success and to the team as a whole:

General PIC Responsibilities

  1. Manage intercompany transactions and regional pricing
  2. Support development of financial forecasts, perform closing activities and analyses of results
  3. Support analysis on manufacturing variances
  4. Ensure compliance with all local government and company regulations, policies, and procedures
  5. Business partnering (i.e. Tax, Compliance, Supply Chain, Leadership Teams)
  6. Share business and financial best practices/procedures across the region
  7. Focus on process improvement and standardization
  8. Promote collaboration and use best practices to provide strategic analytic support to the team and organization
  9. Participate in other special projects as needed
  10. Perform other duties assigned as needed
  11. Coordinate and perform annual costing, ICP, markup setup process
  12. Execute business case modeling and support NPI analysis
  13. Provide cost insights to the business through simulator
  14. Support PnL Bridges and other financial metrics. Explain cost variances for global groups
  15. SLOB / FAA consolidation, DOS Calculation, Net Inventory Reports
  16. Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning to identify and mitigate future risks
  17. Partner closely with Finance Partners to have robust knowledge on the end-to-end costing variation and inventory drivers
  18. Lead FAA analyses and closing activities for FAA supply chain groups

Poucas indústrias passaram por uma revolução tão grande na pandemia da COVID-19 como a do delivery de supermercado. Ao mesmo tempo que muitas empresas consolidadas cresceram ainda mais nesse período, elas ainda não conseguiam entregar uma boa experiência para seus clientes.
E nós sabíamos que o cliente merecia mais. Por isso, resolvemos desenvolver um modelo do zero, com foco total nas pessoas e com a ambição de uma startup que busca a liderança de mercado!
Aí criamos a Daki. :)

Mas não queremos apenas atender expectativas, queremos Surpreender. Ir além do esperado e fazer tudo parecer mágica faz parte do nosso DNA.
Inovar está no nosso dia a dia. Para isso, estamos sempre dispostos a Questionar. Se existe uma forma melhor e mais eficiente, nós vamos atrás dela. Sempre com base em dados e com uma abordagem estruturada para propor mudanças que façam a diferença.

Não nos contentamos em apenas otimizar processos; ambicionamos nos tornar o maior banco em tecnologia financeira, capacitando negócios a prosperarem com soluções que eliminam burocracias e impulsionam a eficiência.

Acreditamos que a chave para revolucionar o sistema financeiro reside na nossa busca incessante por inovação e na nossa capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em soluções impactantes. Cada linha de código, cada nova funcionalidade que desenvolvemos, é destinada a permitir que as empresas foquem no que realmente importa: estratégia e crescimento.

Nosso legado é ambicioso: construir o melhor ecossistema bancário em tecnologia e atendimento para empresas no Brasil. E para alcançar essa visão, precisamos de mentes curiosas, persistentes e apaixonadas por desafios. O Desafio

Como Especialista de Compliance, você será um membro fundamental da equipe, atuando na melhoria de processos e procedimentos frente as regulamentações do Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) e outras normas aplicáveis, com foco em Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) de clientes Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) no contexto de meios de pagamentos e serviços bancários.

  • Atuar frente as etapas do processo de onboarding de clientes (KYC, KYP e KYE), parceiros e funcionários desde a coleta, verificação e análise de informações, para garantir a conformidade com as políticas internas e regulamentações aplicáveis.

  • Acompanhamento de Roadmaps de Implementação: Monitorar e acompanhar a implementação de novas regulamentações, políticas e procedimentos de compliance, garantindo a adequação dos processos da empresa.
  • Relacionamentos Externos: Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos eficazes com órgãos reguladores, outras instituições financeiras e parceiros de negócios, quando necessário.
  • Preparar e enviar os reportes a COAF, conforme exigido pela legislação.
  • Atuar na melhoria de processos e procedimentos da área de compliance, auxiliando na propagação da cultura de riscos.
O que não pode faltar:
  • Experiência prévia comprovada em processos de Due Diligence, preferencialmente em instituições financeiras ou outras entidades participantes do arranjo do PIX.
  • Sólido conhecimento das normas e regulamentações do Banco Central do Brasil (BCB) relacionadas à Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro (PLD) e outros temas de compliance.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e expressão verbal e escrita, com capacidade para gerenciar relacionamentos externos de forma profissional e eficaz.
  • Conhecimento em antifraude e outras áreas relacionadas à segurança financeira.
  • Experiência prévia em relacionamento com bandeiras de cartão (Visa, Mastercard, etc.).
  • Vivência com sistemas relativos a compliance será um diferencial;
  • Inglês avançado (leitura, escrita e conversação).

description:
Para se candidatar a esta vaga clique aqui e crie seu currículo.

Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Designer para integrar nossa equipe!

Este profissional será fundamental na execução da visão estratégica através de design e produção audiovisual, e também na execução prática e aprimoramento contínuo de nossos materiais, alinhando-os aos objetivos de negócio e às últimas tendências do mercado.

Requisitos Indispensáveis

  • Experiência em design e produção audiovisual, com envio do portfólio de projetos executados.
  • Domínio avançado de softwares de edição e pós-produção de vídeo (ex: Adobe Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve) e ferramentas de design gráfico e prototipagem (ex: Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Figma, Sketch).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em metodologias de design centrado no usuário e storytelling visual e audiovisual.
  • Habilidade para gerenciar projetos complexos, multitarefas e colocar a mão na massa na execução das atividades.
  • Excelente comunicação e capacidade de atuar como parceiro estratégico.

Regime de Contratação

CLT

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Convênios Comerciais (farmácia, clube de descontos, Universidades entre outros);
  • Plano de incentivo educacional;
  • Plano odontológico co-participativo (DentalUni);

title: Executivo de Contas (Engenharia Civil e Arquitetura)
description:
Executivo de Contas (Engenharia Civil e Arquitetura)

A indústria da construção civil é a segunda menos digitalizada globalmente, e a Vobi nasceu para revolucioná-la! Nossa missão é empoderar profissionais e pequenos negócios deste setor, conectando toda a indústria em uma única plataforma e fornecendo-lhes todas as ferramentas necessárias para conseguirem entregar projetos e obras incríveis, de maneira transparente, simples e colaborativa.

Estamos em busca de pessoas recém formadas, com muita proatividade, responsabilidade, com espírito de dono e muita vontade de aprender para agregar o nosso time de Vendas, atuando como Inside Sales e nos ajudando a encantar e converter potenciais clientes, além de melhorar continuamente nossos processos.

Se você gosta de desafios e está a fim de sacudir uma indústria tradicional e arcaica por completo, venha falar conosco.

Principais atividades desta posição

  1. Administrar e acompanhar leads dentro do funil de vendas, entendendo as necessidades e fazendo o acompanhamento da performance;
  2. Realizar demonstrações e acompanhamento das propostas;
  3. Auxiliar o time de Marketing e Produto, colhendo feedbacks dos potenciais clientes e buscando alternativas para aumentar a conversão;
  4. Atender potenciais clientes através dos nossos canais de atendimento (WhatsApp, e-mail, chat, entre outros) e fazer follow-ups para convertê-los;
  5. Trabalhar em conjunto com o time para alcançar as metas de vendas e faturamento da empresa.

O que esperamos de você

  1. Graduação em Engenharia Civil ou Arquitetura;
  2. Excelente capacidade de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  3. Perfil investigativo e curioso para solucionar problemas;
  4. Habilidade de organização e gestão de tempo;
  5. Experiência na área de vendas;
  6. Saber trabalhar bem em equipe, e ser flexível para mudanças dentro da função;
  7. Experiência com SaaS (diferencial);
  8. Ter experiência atuando na área da construção civil (desejável).

Porque você vai amar trabalhar com a gente

  1. Remuneração competitiva em relação ao mercado;
  2. Possibilidade de participação societária;
  3. Ambiente descontraído, com muitas oportunidades de crescimento e suporte para desenvolver sua carreira;
  4. Happy Hours mensais, e confraternizações presenciais semestrais;
  5. Day off de aniversário;
  6. Trabalho remoto e flexível;
  7. Liberdade para propor novas ideias e assumir grandes responsabilidades.

Criada por ex-sócios da MAR Ventures - Venture builder com negócios avaliados em mais de R$ 1 bilhão - e investida pela Y Combinator, a Vobi está transformando a indústria da construção civil através da tecnologia!

A Vobi é uma plataforma SaaS de gestão para pequenas e médias empresas do setor, como escritórios de arquitetura, empresas de engenharia e construtoras. Nós os ajudamos a gerenciar melhor os seus projetos, obras e negócio, conectando e fornecendo todas as ferramentas necessárias e eliminando tarefas administrativas e manuais para que se concentrem no crescimento dos seus negócios.

Através plataforma, profissionais e seus clientes conseguem colaborar, planejar, criar orçamentos, realizar compras e fazer pagamentos a fornecedores de produtos ou serviços, em um único local.

Anualmente, mais de R$ 4 bilhões em obras são gerenciadas através da Vobi, e nossa presença já se estende por todos os estados do Brasil.

Pronto(a) para transformar uma indústria extremamente tradicional?!

title: Consultor Comercial
description:
Venha fazer parte do nosso time e impulsionar as vendas de serviços de terceirização de profissionais de tecnologia!

Buscamos um (a) Consultor (a) Comercial Hunter com:
Experiência em vendas de serviços de terceirização de profissionais de TI: Se você já atuou com alocação de profissionais, outsourcing ou hunting de talentos na área de tecnologia, essa vaga é para você!
Carteira de clientes robusta: É essencial que você possua uma extensa rede de contatos e relacionamento com empresas que demandam profissionais de TI, para gerar novas oportunidades de negócio e acelerar o processo de vendas.

Residência em São Paulo: Atuação remota, com encontros semanais com a gestão comercial para update dos novos negócios.

Perfil flexível, adaptável e ágil : O mercado de tecnologia é dinâmico e exige profissionais que se adaptem rapidamente às mudanças, com flexibilidade para atender diferentes demandas e agilidade para fechar negócios.

Hunter nato : Você tem a garra e a proatividade para prospectar novos clientes, qualificar leads e conduzir negociações eficazes até o fechamento das vendas.

Habilidade de comunicação: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara, concisa e persuasiva, construindo relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e colegas.
Orientação para resultados: Foco em atingir metas e superar expectativas, com persistência e determinação.

Responsabilidades:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes, identificando oportunidades de negócio para serviços de terceirização de profissionais de tecnologia.
  • Qualificar leads, entendendo as necessidades dos clientes e apresentando soluções adequadas.
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas e competitivas.
  • Conduzir negociações eficazes, sanando objeções e fechando contratos.
  • Gerenciar a carteira de clientes, mantendo o relacionamento e identificando novas oportunidades de venda.
  • Acompanhar o mercado e as tendências em terceirização de TI para identificar novas oportunidades e desenvolver estratégias de venda.

Oferecemos:
Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e desafiador.
Oportunidade de crescimento profissional e desenvolvimento de carreira.
Remuneração competitiva.
